findings.description: The caption states 2 leaves of 1.200 x 2.134 x 0.045 m in storefront_alu and a total of 88.4 kg. The stated area density is 112.5 kg/m2, so those leaves weigh 576 kg between them: the slab mass has been computed for one leaf and then split across all 2. Every leaf is 2x too light.
